readerCopy.summary: A sudden structural break moves technology, ownership, and authority at the same time.
readerCopy.body: A sudden structural break moves technology, ownership, and authority at the same time. A platform collapses, a market is seized, a supply chain is replaced, or a public movement gains control of tools the old institution assumed it would always hold. Uranus makes the rupture immediate, while Pluto determines who controls the deeper resources after the break. Under the conjunction, disruption and transfer of power become one event. The change may end an outdated system while creating a new concentration of authority before anyone has language for what replaced it.
